title: Scalarization of an Eichler integral is holomorphic
statement: Let n∈ℕ, h:ℍ→ℂ, and E:ℍ→BinaryForm ℂ n satisfy IsEichlerIntegral n h E. Define P:ℂ→ℂ by P(z)=E(ofComplex z)(1,−z). Then P is complex differentiable on {z∈ℂ | Im z>0}. No regularity assumption on h is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h E → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) (E (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im}
